method: Reviewed all48poses on every final beige composited contact sheet, including silhouette continuity, correct direction/state, full anatomy and absence of adjacent-pose fragments. Regenerated/reflowed flagged sheets with imagegen.

repairs.020: background/isolated fragments corrected by reflow then cutout
repairs.024: whisker fragments corrected by reflow,translucent background cleaned with imagegen
repairs.025: tiny detached fragment corrected by reflow
repairs.026: feet crossing source rows corrected by reflow
repairs.028: mouth fragments and white blob corrected by reflow
repairs.030: persistent fragment repaired by clean imagegen rebuild from original
